name: Spotify
author: mathisarends
description: A distraction-free Spotify remote in the Omarchy bar: play, skip, volume, devices, playlists and favorites, powered by the spoti CLI.

barWidget.description: One icon in the bar. Click for a keyboard-first panel: what is playing, transport and volume, the device it plays on, your favorites and a searchable list of your playlists.

schema.label: Preferred device
schema.description: Name or id of the device to start playback on when nothing is active, for example the spotifyd speaker. Empty lets spoti pick the only one online.

schema.label: Volume step (%)
schema.description: How far one scroll notch or one + / - press moves the volume.

schema.label: Show liked songs
schema.description: Liked songs as the first row of the playlist list.

schema.label: Show the track in the bar
schema.description: Title and artist next to the icon while something plays.

schema.label: Track text length
schema.description: Longer bar text is cut with an ellipsis.

schema.label: Show key hints
schema.description: The short shortcut line at the bottom of the panel.

schema.label: spoti command
schema.description: Name or full path of the spoti binary.
